question: Can the frozen V6.1 return ranks plus FF5/momentum alpha gate preserve the hedge benefit of shorts without forcing a structurally loss-making stock-short sleeve?

formation.long_rule: Frozen Step 02 top-20-percent long-return rank plus strictly positive causal FF5/momentum alpha gate.
formation.alpha_short_rule: Frozen Step 02 top-20-percent short-return rank plus strictly negative causal FF5/momentum alpha gate and a stressed round-trip trading-and-borrow hurdle.
formation.opposing_signal_rule: An inherited holding can be reduced or closed but cannot reverse side in the same month.

stock_hedge_pool.rule: For the optional-utility policy only, a non-long, short-eligible and trade-allowed stock can be a hedge candidate when it is in the more liquid half and below the 75th percentile of stressed borrow cost.

policies.description: No side floors. Alpha and hedge stock shorts are jointly selected only when expected net return plus covariance benefit improves mean-variance utility.
Stock shorts must have positive causal expected net edge; a separately reported SPY short supplies residual market-beta hedging.

optimizer.objective: maximize causal expected monthly net excess return minus one-half risk aversion times annualized forecast variance
optimizer.selection_rule: For each policy separately, select the highest primary-cost validation Sharpe; break ties by higher stress Sharpe, lower turnover, then larger risk aversion.

spy_hedge.expected_return_rule: Causal trailing mean SPY excess return, shrunk toward zero by 24 prior months and floored at zero so a SPY short always carries a nonnegative expected opportunity cost.
spy_hedge.specific_variance_rule: Causal trailing variance of SPY excess return minus MKT-RF, shrunk toward a 0.0001 monthly prior over 24 months.

evaluation.primary_metric: realized annualized net Sharpe under primary costs
report_separately: gross, net, beta, volatility, turnover and breadth
evaluation.interpretation: A causal expected-net constraint is valid; a constraint requiring positive future realized short P&L is look-ahead and is not used.
